name: Windows Host (WMI)
description: Credentials for authenticated Windows inventory scans over WMI/DCERPC via the relay agent. Collects installed software, services, patches, shares, and local users without an agent on the host.

steps.instruction: Enter the local or domain user with WMI read access on the target hosts (e.g. a scanning service account). Must be a local Administrator or domain user in the target's local Administrators group — remote WMI requires it.
Enter the password for the account above. Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted in the credential vault.
Enter the NetBIOS or Active Directory domain (leave blank for a local account on a workgroup host).

note.label: Note
note.description: This connector stores credentials only. Scans are triggered from the 'WMI Inventory' page — a connected relay agent and target Windows assets are required.
